newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Israel's Peres to visit Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Peres to visit Argentina.

text.p: Former Israeli prime minister Shimon Peres will visit Argentina April 7-9, the Israeli embassy said on Thursday.
An embassy source said Peres was scheduled to meet President Carlos Menem and would urge the government to solve two major attacks against Jewish targets in Buenos Aires.
"Every time an Israeli leader visits Argentina, he calls for the quick clarification of the attacks and punishment of the guilty," the source said.
In March 1992 a car bomb gutted the embassy building, killing 29 people, and in July 1994 the AMIA Jewish centre exploded in a similar attack which killed 86.

Peres, who helped broker peace accords between Israel and the Palestinians, will also participate in a public ceremony called by the local Jewish community and receive honorary degrees from two universities.
